sloka: राज्ञो वचनम् आज्ञाय सुमन्त्रः शीघ्र विक्रमः ।योजयित्वा आययौ तत्र रथम् अश्वैः अलम्कृतम् ॥२-३९-१२॥
transliteration: rājño vacanam ājñāya sumantraḥ śīghra vikramaḥ ।yojayitvā āyayau tatra ratham aśvaiḥ alamkṛtam ॥2-39-12॥

translations.english: In obedience to the words of the king, Sumantra promptly harnessed the horses to a welldecorated chariot and brought it there.
